_doc: Favours and gifts. Vars: {money} {item} {third} {thirdaddr}. 'ask'/'give' are YOUR lines; the rest are theirs.

ask: I'm short, {first}. Could you lend me {money}? I'll make it good.
Might I borrow {money} until I'm on my feet?
I hate to ask, {addr}, but {money} would save me.
Would you lend me {money}? You have my word on repaying it.

ask.t: I'm good for it, {first}, you know I am. {Money}?

yes.t: Here — {money}. Pay me back when you can, {first}.
Take it. I'd rather you asked a friend than a usurer.
Of course. Don't make me regret it, {addr}.
Say no more. {Money}, and God speed.
Against my better judgement. But you've been good to me.
This is for the kindness your father showed mine.

no.t: I haven't the coin to spare, {first}. Truly.
Ask me another time. Purses are thin just now.
I've lent before and seen nothing in return. I'll not lend again.
I'd like to, {addr}, but I've my own debts.
A loan is a promise. I don't know yours well enough.

owing.t: You still owe me, {first}. Settle that before you ask for more.
Pay what you owe first, {addr}. Then we'll talk.

ask: Here's what I owe you, {first}: {money}. With thanks.
I've not forgotten. {Money}, as I promised.

full.t: A person of your word! That's rare, and I'll remember it.
Thank you, {first}. We're square, and I think the better of you.
Now that's how it's done. God keep you.
I'd not doubted you. But I'll not pretend it isn't welcome.

part.t: Something is better than nothing. The rest will keep.
A start. I'll not press you for the remainder yet.
Thank you. I know it's hard to part with.

ask: I've not eaten since morning. Is there a crust to spare?
My belly is empty, {first}. Might I share your table?
Could you spare me a bite, {addr}? I'd be grateful.
I'm famished. Is there bread about?

yes.t: Sit, sit. There's pottage on the fire and bread to go with it.
Of course. No one goes hungry from my door.
Here — it isn't much, but it's hot.
Eat. We've a little more than most, thank God.
You're thin. Sit down at once.

no.t: I've scarcely enough for my own. Not today, {first}.
The larder's bare. Ask at the church door; they might help.
Cook for yourself like the rest of us.
I'd feed you gladly, but I've mouths enough.

ask: Would you put in a good word for me with {thirdaddr}?
I'd be grateful if you'd speak well of me to {thirdaddr}.
Could you mention my name to {thirdaddr}? Kindly, I mean.

ask.t: You have {thirdaddr}'s ear, {first}. Would you use it for me?

yes.t: I'll see what I can do, {first}. {Third} listens to me, sometimes.
Aye, I'll speak to {third}. Don't give me cause to regret it.
Consider it done. You've been decent to me.
I'll tell {third} you're honest. See that you are.

no.t: I don't carry that much weight with {third}, I'm afraid.
Better you ask yourself. It means more coming from you.
I'd not stake my name on you, {first}. Not yet.
{Third} and I are not on speaking terms. Best not.

ask: Would you teach me my letters, {addr}? I'd be a diligent pupil.
I should like to learn to read. Would you show me?
Might I sit with you and learn some Latin, {first}?
I've a mind to learn my letters. Would you teach me?

yes.t: Come, then. We'll start with the alphabet and the Paternoster.
A wish to learn is a gift. Sit, and pay attention.
Good. Take the slate. Say it after me: A, B, C...
A quick mind. Let's see how far you can get today.

no.t: I haven't time for lessons today, {first}.
Letters are for those with the leisure. Do you have it?
Another day. I'm busy with the Church's affairs.
I'd not waste my breath. Come back when you're calmer.

give: Here — a small gift for you, {first}.
Take this. I'd like you to have it.
This is for you. No obligation.

give.t: I thought of you when I saw this.

thanks.t: Why, thank you, {first}! That's kind indeed.
God bless you for it. I'll not forget this.
You shouldn't have! But I'm glad you did.
Well! A good turn deserves another.
Ah, a gift is a gift. I'll say my thanks and not ask why.
Careful, {first}, or I'll think you fond of me.

suspicious.t: What's this for? I'll take it, but I'll be wondering.
A gift? From you? Hm. What do you want?
I don't know that I can accept this, {first}.
I'll take it. It doesn't mean I've forgotten.

beggar.t: God reward you, {addr}! God reward you a hundredfold!
Bless you. May your table never be bare.
I'll pray for you, {addr}, every night.
A kind soul. They're few. I'll remember you.
